_comment: Composed classroom setup: FinancialLibrary (curated explainers) + FRED + SEC EDGAR + IMF (live official data). Replace the placeholders: the path to your checkout, YOUR OWN free FRED API key (https://fred.stlouisfed.org/docs/api/api_key.html), and your name + email for the SEC EDGAR user agent. Never commit a real key. The FRED and EDGAR servers are AGPL-3.0 — run them unmodified, as here. MIT alternative for FRED: replace the fred entry with a pip-installed server from https://github.com/floriancaro/fred-mcp-server. See ../ECOSYSTEM.md.
